ns2:course.label: Studies in Francophonie
ns2:course.description: Study of various topics in French language, literature, and culture outside of France. Regions may include francophone Africa, the Americas, Europe, and the Middle East. Same as CWL 434. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours. May be repeated to a maximum of 12 undergraduate hours or 16 graduate hours if topics vary.
